## Summary

Update all affected documentation for the automatic Phase Shift behaviour (parent AH-0MUIYX1EE008FVS8). Per parent AC7. `CHANGELOG.md` is excluded (release-pipeline managed).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC7.1 — `docs/Game Design Document.md` §4.4 P6/P7 entries describe automatic danger-triggered activation, the 1.5 s duration, the charge/permanent model, the 40 px / ≥ 3 danger rule and the ~0.5 s re-arm cooldown.
- [ ] AC7.2 — `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` hit-gating notes reflect the retained pass-through and the new mineral-collection gate.
- [ ] AC7.3 — `README.md` describes the automatic Phase Shift and finite/unlimited charges.
- [ ] AC7.4 — In-code JSDoc/comments in `src/powerups/effects.ts`, `src/powerups/dangerDetection.ts` and the shared scenes describe the new semantics and cite the producer decisions.
- [ ] AC7.5 — Documentation uses UK English and matches the shipped constants.
- [ ] AC7.6 — No reference to the retired 3 s P6 duration remains in docs or code comments (except historical work-item references).

- [ ] Traceability — parent AC7 (AH-0MUIYX1EE008FVS8): [ ] **AC7 — Documentation.** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, `README.md`, `docs/Game Design Document.md` (§4.4 P6/P7 entries) and `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` hit-gating notes. (`CHANGELOG.md` is managed by the release pipeline and is excluded.)


## Minimal Implementation

- Update the three docs and the module/scene comments; keep edits surgical.

**Key Files:**
- `docs/Game Design Document.md`
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`
- `README.md`

## Dependencies

- Depends on **C1–C6** (documents the delivered behaviour).

Parent: AH-0MUIYX1EE008FVS8.
